decisionsTitle: «Ambasador»: a second mark beside «Elită», with the elite's two ticks and the ordinary bib; and «Șterge» on an invitation that ended unaccepted (amending §897, §910 and §647)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-14, with a picture of an event's registrations list and of one row of it — an invitation, «Invitație retrasă», whose only press was «Vezi invitația»:** "pe langa Elite, adauga si categoria de \"Ambasadori\" ca sa putem decite pe cine premiem si pe cine nu", and: "Si mai am o problema, am o invitatie retreasa, vreau sa o pot sterge!". Asked what the mark «Ambasador» should do on a registration, he chose: «Ca «Elită», fără BIB special».

**Where it stood.** The club had one category of invited runner, «Elită» (§897): a mark on a registration that prints its bib as an elite's and, since §910, brings two ticks — «Apare în clasament», which unticked runs the result hors concours, and «Apare pe site», which unticked hides the name the runner's own tick shows. A club ambassador who runs the race had no mark at all, so on «Clasament» and at «Premii» nothing told the club whose result it was looking at. And an invitation that ended unaccepted — withdrawn by the club, or past its deadline — stayed on the list and in the «Invitații» panel until the retention job took it, thirty days after it ended (§647): the Administrator who withdrew one sent by mistake kept reading it for a month.

**Decision — «Ambasador».** A second mark on a registration, `registrations.ambassador`, set from the same places as «Elită»: the row's «⋮» on the registrations list («Marchează ca ambasador» / «Nu mai e ambasador»), and a one-press «Nu mai e ambasador» on each line of a new closed fold «Ambasadori» beside «Elite», which lists the event's ambassadors by name in every state, each with its state, its number, «și elită» when it wears both marks, and what the two ticks hide of it. It is the Administrator's, at any time and in any state, asserted at the action and again in the service (BR-REQ-060-01); the Organizer reads the chip and the fold and is offered no press. It asks no question, as the elite's mark does not: it emails nobody, the same menu undoes it. The trail: `registration.ambassador_marked` / `registration.ambassador_unmarked`, the new value alone.

**What the mark is.** A label, and the two ticks it brings. The label changes nothing of the registration: not its state, its place, its race number, a count, the kits, the queue or an email — the allocator and the capacity formula never read it — and not the bib, which prints as any other, the number where the number goes (that is «fără BIB special»). The backoffice says it: the chip «Ambasador» on the list and on the registration's page, and — so the club can decide whom it awards — beside the runner's name on every registered line of «Clasament» and on the podium rows of «Premii», where «Elită» is now said the same way; a line the tick left out of the ranking says by which mark («ambasador în afara clasamentului», an elite's as before). Nothing public says it: the published results, the participants' list, the desk, the emails, the bibs, the registrations' Excel and CSV and the lists given to sponsors carry neither a field nor a word of it, and a guard lists every file that may name the mark. The one file that holds it is the person's own data («Toate datele unei persoane», the answer to an access request), which carries every column of their registration.

**The two ticks are the registration's one pair.** «Apare în clasament» and «Apare pe site» are §910's columns and §910's presses, unchanged in what they do; what changes is when they count: while the registration is marked «Elită» **or** «Ambasador». So an ambassador unticked from «Apare în clasament» is out of the public results, of everybody's position and so of «Premii», its line kept on the backoffice's «Clasament» as «în afara clasamentului»; and unticked from «Apare pe site» it reads on the public list and in the published results as a runner who did not tick «Vreau să apar» — «Participant (nume ascuns)», still counted. A staff tick only ever hides: nobody is shown whom their own tick does not show. The ticks are offered in the row's «⋮» and on the registration's page under whichever mark it wears; a registration with both marks has one pair, and taking one mark off leaves the ticks counting under the other. The ticks' server refusal (`ELITE_NOT_MARKED`) now refuses only a registration that wears neither. Putting the ambassador's mark on or taking it off re-ranks the stored results in the same transaction, and tells the public pages after it, only where that changes what the ticks do — on a registration that is not an elite and has a tick unticked.

**Decision — «Șterge» on an ended invitation.** An Administrator deletes an invitation that ended unaccepted — withdrawn, or past its deadline — from its line in the «Invitații» panel and from its row on the registrations list, behind a question that names the person and says nobody is emailed. The row goes with its link (a link already in somebody's inbox stops working, as after the retention job); the trail keeps `event.invitation_deleted` on the event with the invitation's id and how it ended, never a name or an address. The server refuses an invitation still open — it holds a place, and «Retrage» is the press that gives the place back, through the allocator — and one that became a registration, which goes with its registration (`INVITATION_NOT_ENDED`, said in words). One past its deadline that the job has not stamped yet is ended first by the event's own sweep, so its place is offered to the line exactly as the job would have offered it; that is why the press is an emailing press, with its own cause. The Organizer is offered no «Șterge» and is refused at the action and in the service. The retention job is unchanged: what nobody deletes still goes thirty days after it ended.

**Refused.** A bib of its own for ambassadors: the owner chose none. A second pair of ticks, or separate columns per mark: one runner is in the ranking or out of it, on the site or off it — two pairs could disagree about the same person. A public «Ambasadorii cursei» list or a word on the published results: the public list is a disclosure (BR-REQ-039-01) and nobody asked for one. Marking an ambassador out of the ranking by default: the mark alone moves nothing, the club unticks whom it means to. Deleting an open invitation in one press: it would give a counted place back outside the withdrawal's own path. Deleting an accepted one: that is a registration, and erasing a registration is its own audited verb. Keeping the deleted person's name in the trail: the trail names who deleted and what, as an erasure's does.

Migration `0201_registration_ambassador` (expand only: one boolean column, `false` by default). No new dependency.
changelogLine: - **«Ambasador» beside «Elită», and «Șterge» on an ended invitation** — an Administrator marks a registration «Ambasador» from the list's «⋮»: a chip on the list, on the registration's page, in «Clasament» and at «Premii», a closed fold «Ambasadori» beside «Elite», the bib as any other, and the elite's two ticks — «Apare în clasament» (unticked: out of the ranking and of the awards) and «Apare pe site» — one pair whichever mark the registration wears; nothing public names the mark. An invitation that was withdrawn or ran past its deadline can be deleted, from the «Invitații» panel and from its row on the list, behind a question; an open one is withdrawn first. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an invitation that ended unaccepted — withdrawn, or past its deadline, stamped by the sweep or not — when an Administrator presses «Șterge» on its line of the «Invitații» panel or on its row of the registrations list and confirms the question, which names the person and says nobody is emailed, then the invitation and its link are deleted and `event.invitation_deleted` records the invitation's id and how it ended, never a name or an address; one past its deadline and not yet swept is first ended by the event's sweep, which offers its place to the line; an invitation still open, or one that became a registration, is refused in words (`INVITATION_NOT_ENDED`) and nothing is written; a second press finds no invitation (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration an Administrator marked «Ambasador» from the registrations list's «⋮» or unmarked from there or from the «Ambasadori» fold — at any time and in any state — then its bib prints as any other registration's and its state, place, race number and printed mark stay as they were, `countOccupied`, the kits, the registrations' summary and the places line count it as before, and no email is queued; a press that finds the mark already as asked writes nothing (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration marked «Ambasador», when an Administrator unticks its «Apare pe site», then the public list and the published results read it as one that did not tick «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți» — an unnamed, counted row while confirmed — and a runner who did not tick is never shown, whatever the mark and the club's tick say; the tick counts while the registration is marked «Elită» or «Ambasador» and is inert under neither; and no public page, published result, email, desk screen, bib, registrations export or list given to sponsors carries the mark, as a field or as a word — the person's own data («Toate datele unei persoane») holds it, with every column of their registration (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race with results, when an Administrator unticks «Apare în clasament» on a registration marked «Ambasador», then its result stays on «Clasament» as «în afara clasamentului» and is out of the public results, of every other runner's position — stored and read — and of «Premii», and comes back with the tick; the mark alone moves nothing; the one pair of ticks counts under either mark, so taking one of two marks off keeps the runner out and taking the last one off ranks them again in the same transaction; and the backoffice's «Clasament» and «Premii» say «Elită» and «Ambasador» beside the runner's name on a registered line, never on a line typed by hand (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the ambassador's mark, the pair of ticks on a registration that wears it, and «Șterge» on an ended invitation, then only an Administrator changes them — the Organizer, Tehnic and every other role refused at each Server Action and again in the service, with nothing written — while the «Ambasador» chip and the «Ambasadori» fold are read by whoever reads the registrations list and by nobody else, and the Organizer is offered none of the presses (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Ambasador» beside «Elită», with the elite's two ticks and the ordinary bib; «Șterge» on an invitation that ended unaccepted
